properties.displayName: Management ports should be closed on your virtual machines
properties.description: Open remote management ports expose your VM to a high level of risk from Internet-based attacks. These attacks attempt to brute force credentials to gain admin access to the machine.
properties.remediationDescription:
Restrict access to the ports with an NSG rule, or use just-in-time VM access.
Prefer Azure Bastion for interactive sessions.

properties.displayName: Accounts with owner permissions on Azure resources should be MFA enabled
properties.description: Multi-Factor Authentication should be enabled for all subscription accounts with owner permissions to prevent a breach of accounts or resources.
properties.remediationDescription: Require MFA for the accounts with Owner through Conditional Access.

properties.displayName: Storage account public access should be disallowed
properties.description: Anonymous public read access to containers and blobs is a convenient way to share data but might present security risks.
properties.remediationDescription: Set allowBlobPublicAccess to false on the storage account.

properties.displayName: Key vaults should have deletion protection enabled
properties.description: Malicious deletion of a key vault can lead to permanent data loss. Purge protection enforces a mandatory retention period for soft deleted key vaults.
properties.remediationDescription: Enable soft delete and purge protection on the vault.

properties.displayName: Kubernetes Services should be upgraded to a non-vulnerable Kubernetes version
properties.description: Upgrade your Kubernetes service cluster to a later Kubernetes version to protect against known vulnerabilities in your current version.
properties.remediationDescription: Upgrade the cluster's control plane and node pools to a supported version.

properties.displayName: Container registries should have local admin account disabled
properties.description: Disable the admin account on your registry and use Microsoft Entra identities instead.
properties.remediationDescription: Turn off the admin user (Access keys → Admin user).

properties.displayName: SQL servers should have an Azure Active Directory administrator provisioned
properties.description: Provision a Microsoft Entra administrator for your SQL server to enable Entra authentication.
properties.remediationDescription: Set a Microsoft Entra admin on the server.

properties.displayName: Endpoint protection should be installed on your machines
properties.description: To protect your machines from threats and vulnerabilities, install a supported endpoint protection solution.
properties.remediationDescription: Onboard the machine to Defender for Endpoint.
